body:
There's a reason copper has been worn on the body for centuries — it's a natural conductor, and when it sits directly against your skin, it stays in constant contact with your energy field. The Solid Copper Ring takes that principle and distills it into its simplest form: a smooth, rounded band with a single embedded magnetic point, designed to be worn daily without a second thought.

This isn't a ring you dress up for — it's the one you forget you're wearing, which is exactly the point. Copper works best with consistency, and this design was made for exactly that. The high-polish finish keeps it sleek enough to stack with your favorite pieces or wear completely on its own, while the weight and shape are substantial enough to feel intentional every time you catch it in the light.

The single magnetic point is embedded discreetly along the inner band, adding a layer of energetic focus to the ring's natural conductivity. Think of it as a quiet anchor — a small, steady pulse that keeps you tethered to the present moment, wherever your day takes you.

We designed this piece for the person who wants their tools to work without asking much of them. No routine to remember, no crystal to charge — just copper, doing its job, one wear at a time. Whether you're new to energy work or you've been at this a while, the Solid Copper Ring is a low-lift, high-impact way to bring a little more grounding into your everyday.
